scope: Bounded qualification of reviewed named fixtures only. Each claim describes the assertion actually exercised; unspecified stages remain unqualified. Passing blocker fixtures do not establish operation completion.
target_domain: The AGENTS.md algebraic closure contract and M0-M6/A1-A4 remain the target. Native and generated instances are identified independently. This catalog is an initial subset, not an exhaustive family or degeneracy inventory.
unqualified_targets: General algebraic coefficients and arbitrary-degree implicit region admission and operations.
Generated native save/reload in a fresh process followed by another modeling operation.
Complete nonrational ellipse, parabola and PH offset chains, singular events and overlap correspondences.
Invalid operands paired with canonical empty, full disappearance chains and all hole/disconnected configurations.
Total arithmetic, coefficient/system growth, retained-memory limits and cooperative cancellation.
Published package and actual binding consumers for the complete declared domain.
